# Decks Plus

> Decks Plus is an owner-operated outdoor living specialist based in Kokomo, Indiana, serving Hamilton County (Carmel, Fishers, Noblesville, Westfield) and Central Indiana. Owner: Allen Richards. Phone: (765) 210-0027. Email: allenbuilds11@gmail.com.

Decks Plus builds custom decks, patios, fire pits, outdoor kitchens, pergolas, gazebos, fencing, sunrooms, and waterfront docks. Free on-site estimates.

## Pages

- [Home](https://decksplus.example.com/): Overview, featured before/after project, service area.
- [Decks](https://decksplus.example.com/decks/): Custom wood and composite deck building.
- [Patios, Fire Pits & Outdoor Kitchens](https://decksplus.example.com/patios-fire-pits/): Flagstone patios, built-in fire pits, outdoor kitchens.
- [Pergolas & Gazebos](https://decksplus.example.com/pergolas-gazebos/): Custom pergolas and covered outdoor structures.
- [Fencing & Custom Builds](https://decksplus.example.com/fencing-outdoor-structures/): Fencing, sunrooms, docks, custom builds.
- [Portfolio](https://decksplus.example.com/portfolio/): Before-and-after project gallery.
- [Service Area](https://decksplus.example.com/service-areas/): Hamilton County, Carmel, Fishers, Noblesville, Westfield, Kokomo, and Howard County.
- [About](https://decksplus.example.com/about/): About owner Allen Richards and the company.
- [Contact](https://decksplus.example.com/contact/): Phone, email, and contact form.
